content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High rate of SSO token exchange failures from auth-proxy-prod -> external host 54.233.12.99. 600 failures in 2m, unusual egress pattern. Auto-paged: #incidents and @dan-oncall.

alice: seeing same in dashboards, spikes started ~3190000000. No customer-facing errors yet but auth latency up 20%.

ben: digging into proxy logs now. quick snip: `POST /oauth/token 401 x-forwarded-for: 203.0.113.45` repeated, then sudden large outbound to 54.233.12.99:443.

carmen: tagging sec. Possible exfil or misconfigured mirror. @security-sarah can you assess whether this is an internal service misroute vs attacker?

security-sarah: on it. Initial check: 54.233.12.99 not in our allowlist or vendor list. Confirmed some requests include X-Forwarded-Client-Cert headers and large request bodies (~200KB). Could be log forwarding.

dan-oncall: I'm going to quarantine auth-proxy-prod host group and add egress deny to 54.233.12.99 in firewall. Will also scale up logging retention for last 24h.

alice: please also add a temporary rate limit on /oauth/token and enable 2xx->alert for unusual response sizes.

ben: applied egress block via NACL and updated WAF rule to block that host. Rolling restart auth-proxy pool for new rules.

security-sarah: next steps: 1) rotate service account keys used by auth-proxy (svc-auth-proxy) 2) revoke active SSO sessions older than 12h for affected tenants 3) scan recent logs for any PII or token strings sent to 54.233.12.99.

support-lead-maya: heads-up: a few customers in EU may see transient 401s while we revoke sessions. We'll prepare a brief status update once we confirm scope.

carmen: I'm creating IR ticket IR-2026-3190. Including logs, pcap of outbound connections, and list of affected tenants. Assigning to sec-eng and SRE.

ben: collecting binaries and container images used on those hosts for forensic snapshot. Saving out `/var/log/auth-proxy/*.log` and `/opt/containers/auth-proxy/image-id.txt` to secure bucket `s3://redwood-incident-3190` (restricted).

security-sarah: executed key rotation for svc-auth-proxy: new keys pushed to secrets-manager, old keys disabled but kept for 1h for rollback. Rotating now for dependent services: web-sso, idp-sync.

dan-oncall: session invalidation job queued, estimated 15m to finish, prioritized high for tenants showing outbound hits.

alice: monitoring customer impact: auth latency back to baseline after egress block; rate limit holding. No confirmed token exfil yet but scanning ongoing.

support-lead-maya: drafting customer note: "We detected unusual outbound traffic from auth service and proactively blocked the destination. We're rotating credentials and invalidating sessions; you may see short-lived reauth prompts." Will post to status.redwo od.com/incident once we have confirmed tenant list.

security-sarah: evidence update: found 12 log lines with full bearer tokens in proxied payloads to 54.233.12.99. Treat as suspected leak. Recommendations: immediate mandatory rotation for API keys and client secrets for customers where tokens appear, plus legal/infosec escalation.

carmen: escalation: paging legal and privacy, initiating customer-impact classification (P0/P1). Adding tag P1 until we confirm sensitive data exfil.

ben: forensic snapshots uploaded. Created allowlist exception review to verify no other hosts were compromised.

alice: assigning followups: @security-sarah to own evidence & customer classification; @ben to complete forensic deliverables; @dan-oncall to confirm full session invalidation; @support-lead-maya to publish customer comms.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Incident IR-2026-3190 created. Priority: P1. Current status: containment in progress, keys rotated, sessions invalidated (partial). Next update in 30m or on significant change.

security-sarah: noted. If any team finds retained logs with tokens, move them to the secure bucket and mark chain-of-custody. Also recommend emergency rotate for any service accounts that used the old secrets.

support-lead-maya: published preliminary status page: "Investigating unusual outbound traffic from auth-proxy; mitigation in progress." Sending to CSMs now.

alice: thanks all. Keep messages concise in this thread only. If anyone needs to join war room, DM and I'll create VC. :thumbsup:
